title: fix(ui-merge): two tests that #25745 broke on main read the merged tree — the Changesets config through changesetConfigPath(), the SDUI html tier by its tags (#25711)

Follow-up to #25745 (4a), per ruling 30 = B: the two Test UI / Test Core reds that #25745 caused once it merged are fixed here, on the same card. Test-only; nothing is released, so this carries `skip-changeset`.

## What changes

**1. Test UI shard 3/16: `ui/packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts`.** The release-lockstep test read `ui/.changeset/config.json`, which #25745 deleted (Changesets reads one config per repository). It now reads the config through `changesetConfigPath()` from `ui/scripts/workspace-root.mjs`, the helper every other reader of the Changesets config already uses: the tree's own config when standalone, the monorepo root's when nested under `ui/`.

**2. Test Core 5/8: `packages/lint/src/validate-jsx-pages.production-witness.test.ts`.** The witness asserted that the SDUI manifest contains the `html` component. objectui#13449 retired `html`, and the manifest #25745 regenerated from the in-tree `ui/` has 106 components, without it. The witness now pins the html tier by two of its intrinsic tags (`a`, `p`). The shipped pages never used the raw `html` component, and the clean-run witness in the same file still checks them.

## Verification (this branch, on `main` 2a61f08093)

- `app-generator.test.ts`: 48/48 pass. Without fix 1: 1 failed / 47 passed (ENOENT on `ui/.changeset/config.json`).
- Test UI shard 3/16, built the CI way (the 7-package turbo build, then `pnpm --dir ui run test --shard=3/16`): 361 files passed, 1 skipped; 4,724 tests passed, 102 skipped.
- `validate-jsx-pages.production-witness.test.ts`: 5/5 pass. Also green: `@objectstack/sdui-parser` 225/225, the cli sdui test files 79/79, app-showcase metric-filter 7/7.
